LightningComponentBundle.description: Small multiples sparkline grid for entity comparison, powered by D3.js.

property.name: entityField
property.label: Entity Field
property.description: API name of the field to group entities by (e.g., Type, Owner)

property.name: dateField
property.label: Date Field
property.description: API name of the date field for the time axis

property.name: valueField
property.label: Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field to aggregate

property.name: operation
property.label: Aggregation
property.description: How to aggregate the values within each month bucket. On the GraphQL self-fetch path the grid fetches raw records bounded to the first Record Limit rows (default 2000).

property.name: height
property.label: Height (px)
property.description: Chart height in pixels

property.name: theme
property.label: Color Theme
property.description: Color palette for the chart

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object to query. When set (and no records are passed in), the grid self-fetches this object via GraphQL. Also used for drill-down navigation on row click.

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down (defaults to Entity Field)

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum records to fetch on the structured self-fetch path. A free-text GraphQL Query is bounded only by its own first: clause. Leave empty for default (2000).

property.name: graphqlFilter
property.label: GraphQL Filter (JSON)
property.description: Optional filter for the structured self-fetch, as JSON: {"field":"Name","operator":"like","value":"[D3DEMO]%"}. Operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, in. Ignored when records are passed in or a GraphQL Query override is set.

property.name: graphqlQuery
property.label: GraphQL Query
property.description: Optional override of the built query. Must be a UI API record query (uiapi.query) whose node selects the Entity Field, Date Field, and Value Field as top-level fields; the returned rows are grouped by Entity Field and bucketed by month client-side using the Aggregation. UI-API-queryable objects only; at most 2,000 records; GraphQL syntax. Footgun: if the Value Field is missing from the query, sums bucket to zero rather than erroring. Leave blank to build the query automatically.

property.name: advancedConfig
property.label: Advanced Config (JSON)
property.description: {"sparkType": "line", "referenceLine": "average", "customColors": ["#1589EE"]}
